channel.title: Brivellis Insights

item.title: ISO/IEC 27001 audit questions: ten things auditors ask your team, and answers that hold up

item.description: Twelve ISO 27001 interview questions for audit and GRC roles: what the interviewer is checking, a strong answer, and a free way to build a work sample.
